title: Ben Is Ill
text:
Ben is ill. He has a cough and a sore throat. He drinks warm tea. He does not go to school.

His dad takes him to the doctor. The doctor gives him a small bottle of medicine. Ben takes the medicine every day. After one week, he is well again.

options: a cough and a sore throat

questions.text: Who takes Ben to the doctor?
Why does Ben stay at home?
options: He is ill and needs rest
He wants to visit a friend

questions.text: How does Ben probably feel at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a sound you make when air is pushed out of your throat, often when you are ill
a person who helps sick people
something you take to help you get better when you are ill

paragraph_translations: Ben jest chory. Ma kaszel i ból gardła. Pije ciepłą herbatę. Nie idzie do szkoły.
Jego tata zabiera go do lekarza. Lekarz daje mu małą butelkę lekarstwa. Ben bierze lekarstwo każdego dnia. Po tygodniu jest znowu zdrowy.
